decisions.why: Mends a wrong outcome of T313's queue (it named READY a command make builder-brief refuses), which fix-as-we-go and constitution XIV require; the GM's T313 words ask the tooling to keep tasks in flight, and a notice that names the command that runs serves that, whereas a skip would hold back work the brief takes under SIZING_OK=. Asking the same mechanism test as the refusal, pinned by a test that the flagged entry is refused by builder_brief::run, keeps flag and refusal from drifting.
